task: Extend the ABI-v10 open-summary codec to preserve typed operator requirements.
observation: The codec roundtrip and nonweakening tests can be extended at the wire-record layer without changing checker adapters. Adding the summary record version to the semantic/private record dispatch was also necessary so version 2 summaries reach the strict decoder while old version 1 summaries fail there.
impact: The focused codec tests now verify exact typed fields, tamper rejection, ordinal bounds, and imported requirement preservation independently of checker wiring.

resolution.summary: Version 2 carries argument TypeExprs, optional result TypeExpr, and ordered argument access modes; the checker remains unconnected.
